*F-FHE* (Threshold FHE decryption) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Until recently this functionality was open; a 2025 paper on high-throughput universally composable threshold FHE decryption moved it from open to canonical, retiring one of the field's longest-standing gaps.

Checked 21 August 2026: the paper below prints two functionalities, and both belong elsewhere. $\mathcal{F}_{\mathsf{ABB}}$ is [*F-ABB*](/uc/layer-6-secret-sharing-mpc/f-abb/index.qmd)'s object (already written); $\mathcal{F}_{\mathsf{Decrypt}}$ (Figure 2) is [*F-thdec*](/uc/layer-6-secret-sharing-mpc/f-thdec/index.qmd)'s (already written, box and all — the two independently converge almost line for line, confirming it's the right home). Neither is a general FHE functionality: $\mathcal{F}_{\mathsf{Decrypt}}$ decrypts one already-computed LWE ciphertext, and says nothing about the homomorphic evaluation that produced it. This slot still needs a forward search for a paper that actually prints an FHE-evaluation functionality, not just threshold decryption of its output; the citation below is kept because it correctly motivates the *decryption* half, but on its own it cannot supply this page's box.

*References:*

- Zyskind et al. [*High-throughput universally composable threshold FHE decryption*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2025/1781). In ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS), 2025. Its $\mathcal{F}_{\mathsf{ABB}}$ and $\mathcal{F}_{\mathsf{Decrypt}}$ belong to F-ABB and F-thdec respectively, not to this page.
